_meta.note: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (2026-09-10, MIT, 552B backbone CED MoE, 8B/16B active, 1M ctx, native vision). Tech report (51 pp) archived as resource/deepseek_v4.1_tech_report_2026-09.pdf; deepseek.com and api-docs.deepseek.com refuse direct connections from this host, so those two pages were read through the r.jina.ai reader proxy and the launch table image via an image proxy. Ingested: Table 1 base (20 rows), Table 3 instruct (21 own rows incl. HLE text-only), Table 4/5 scaffold runs (16 rows), Appendix B.3 effort prose (AIME 2026 100 at max, Apex 25.3 at effort 25), Section 5.3.5 multi-agent scaling endpoints (4 rows), Figure 1(b) KV-cache bytes/token (3 DeepSeek generations), official pricing. The V4-Pro-0813 / V4-Flash-0731 columns (DeepSeek's own previous models, column identity fixed by the deepseek.com image) fill only rows the DB lacked. Competitor columns (Opus 5, GPT-5.6 Sol, K3, GLM-5.3) not ingested. NL2Repo-Bench: report + news say 65.4, HF card 64.0 → 65.4. Withheld: Figures 7/8/9/11/12 curve points (axes only), Table 19-style qualitative material, Figure 6 BPB on internal corpora, the reasoning-effort tier mapping (Table 2: max=100/high=75/low=50, metadata only).
